issues.title: knowledge-runtime scope_requires_pushdown suppresses hybrid search fallback for domain-scoped queries
issues.root_cause: When scope_has_extra_dimensions() returns true (scope.domain is set), the code returns projection_results directly without attempting the hybrid search fallback. Any consumer of KnowledgeRuntime with scope.domain set never gets FTS5/HNSW/RRF search.
issues.fix: Change pushdown branch to fall back to hybrid search when projection_results.len() < leg.limit.
issues.acceptance: KnowledgeRuntime.query() with scope.domain set returns hybrid search results when projection results are thin. Recall retrieval works through knowledge-runtime path.

issues.title: unreachable!() in 3 production code paths
issues.root_cause: unreachable!() panics unconditionally. PlanKind::LlmGenerated is on the roadmap and will hit the act.rs match arm.
issues.fix: Replace with proper error returns: Err(PilotError::Other(format!("unsupported plan kind: {:?}", plan)))
issues.acceptance: No unreachable!() in non-test .rs files. grep confirms zero matches.

issues.title: No HTTP timeout on TUI reqwest clients
issues.root_cause: reqwest::Client::new() has no timeout. Ollama hangs during model loading block TUI indefinitely.
issues.acceptance: grep 'Client::new()' in main_support returns zero matches.

issues.title: main_support/mod.rs 1,591-line monolith
issues.root_cause: CLI parsing, TUI loop, LLM chat, streaming, formatting, storage, status management all in one file.
issues.fix: Split into cli.rs, tui.rs, provider.rs, explain.rs, storage.rs.
issues.acceptance: No file in forge-pilot exceeds 600 lines. cargo check passes.

issues.title: Unbounded PilotHistory growth in daemon mode
issues.root_cause: prior_attempt_bundle_ids and prior_outcomes grow without bound. Daemon mode makes sessions indefinite.
issues.fix: Cap both vectors at 20 entries. Drain oldest on overflow.
issues.acceptance: After 50 iterations, Vec lengths are capped at 20.

issues.title: DefaultHasher used for deterministic digest
issues.root_cause: DefaultHasher is not stable across Rust versions. Digest flows into VerificationCase reports.
issues.fix: Replace with blake3::hash (already a workspace dep).
issues.acceptance: grep 'DefaultHasher' in forge-pilot returns zero matches.

issues.title: Missing NaN/infinity validation on HNSW insert
issues.root_cause: Validates length but not element values. NaN embedding degrades all searches.
issues.acceptance: Test that inserting NaN vector returns Err.

issues.title: Profile composition thin test coverage
issues.location: profile-runtime/src/compose.rs (982 lines, 26 functions) vs tests/ (364 lines, 13 tests)
issues.root_cause: 7 fold classes with exception handling and conflict detection insufficiently tested. No adversarial composition scenarios.
issues.fix: Add proptest for random obligation contribution sets verifying fold invariants.
issues.acceptance: proptest with 256 cases passes for all fold classes.
